metadataRaw.title: How to Fix Quadriceps Pain FOR GOOD
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows how to quickly relieve quadriceps muscle tightness and pain in a step-by-step guide. 

The quadriceps (commonly known as the quad muscles or quads) is a common cause of pain in the front of the thigh, especially above the knee. 

What causes this is tightness and weakness in the quads, and the tendons that attach to the knee (known as quadriceps or patellar tendonitis). To get quick relief, this video will be broken up into three separate parts to fix this. 

To get the best results, make sure to go through all parts (and exercises). 

As a bonus, all of these exercises can be done at home, require no special equipment, and may give quick pain relief... even in as little as 30 SECONDS!

Watch now and get rid of quadriceps muscle pain for good!

Chapters:
0:00 Intro
1:12 Muscle Warm Up
4:17 Strengthening Exercise 
6:50 Stretching Exercise 
9:28 Muscle Massage
